## Highlights

- `n8n workflow diff` — compare saved workflow definitions across two contexts, no mutations. Match by `--from-id` / `--to-id` or `--name`, filter with `--only`, `--include-pinned-data`, `--include-static-data`. Text = unified diff, `--output json` = machine diff with JSON Pointer paths. Exit codes: 0 equal, 1 different, 2 error. Read-only.
- `n8n update` — self-update CLI from GitHub releases. `n8n update --check` reports installed vs latest, writes nothing. Plain run prompts before replace; `--yes` for scripts, `--version vX.Y.Z` pins tag. Verifies checksums.txt + version before swap. Refuses dev builds / package-manager-owned binaries unless `--force`. Contexts + creds survive.
- `n8n execution trace` — per-node trace of one run: status, duration, error class/message. `EXECUTION_ID` or `--workflow-id` for latest run. `--follow` polls every `--interval` (default 2s), prints nodes as they appear, exits on terminal status. Warns if workflow `Save execution progress` off (`--no-preflight` skips). `--output json` = object, NDJSON when following. `--fail-on-error` exits 1 on error/crashed.
- `n8n execution watch` — live execution list. Polls every `--interval` (default 2s), redraws dashboard on TTY, timestamped tables when piped. `--follow` = one line per new/changed run. Filters: `--workflow-id`, `--project-id`, `--status` same as `list`. `--nodes` adds NODES + ERROR columns (1 extra req per changed run). `--output json` = NDJSON. Ctrl+C exits 0. Read-only, needs only `execution:list`.

## Breaking change

- `n8n execution stop-many` now requires explicit scope: `--workflow-id ID` or `--all`. Omitting both errors. `--workflow-id all` rejected, use `--all`. Prevents accidental global stop. Update scripts: append `--all` for old default behavior.
